name: Agent Architecture Advisor
description: Reviews an existing Copilot Studio or Azure AI Foundry agent for architectural problems, modernizes a classic (topic-based) Copilot Studio agent into the new agentic multi-agent structure, or designs the architecture for a new one. Classifies every finding as a configuration issue, a design issue, or a genuine platform ceiling — then recommends staying put, extending with a hybrid, or migrating, with cost break-even and simulated production failures as evidence. Pulls guidance and pricing live from official Microsoft links.
author: Anamika Kumari & Shilpa Gangaramani
